versions.content: For reception the Ethernet Controller shall enable hardware capabilities to discard frames with mismatching protocol checksums (offloading) according to the following list: a) for IPv4 frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumIPv4 is se t to TRUE b) for ICMP frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumICMP is set to TRUE c) for TCP frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumTCP is set to TRUE d) for UDP frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumUDP is set to TRUE. In all other cases, the Ethernet Contro ller shall not consider the protocol checksum fields.
